# Carlos Daniel

> Backend and AI engineer in Cochabamba, Bolivia. I build production RAG systems on AWS Bedrock and real-time backends. Open to full-time roles.

## Case studies

- [FormCore: Multi-Tenant Form Backend](https://carlitosdaniel.com/work/formcore/): Postgres row-level security, not application code, decides who can see which rows.
- [Centinela: Enterprise RAG Microservice](https://carlitosdaniel.com/work/centinela/): hexagonal vector-search service with swappable embedding model and vector store.
- [End-to-End RAG & AI Agent Service](https://carlitosdaniel.com/work/rag-agent/): hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval with query reformulation, streamed answers and asynchronous ingestion.
- [Multiplayer Texas Hold'em](https://carlitosdaniel.com/work/poker/): real-time poker with a tested game engine, per-viewer privacy over SignalR and passwordless identity.
